description: Set this agent's status line: what it is doing, in one line that expires on its own (ttl_seconds, 1 second to a day, an hour by default). A new line replaces the old one. Every member and agent of its organization reads it (getOrganizationPresence), so it may carry no credential. Agent JWT.

agent_jwt.description: Optional: an agent JWT from getAgentToken (speak as that agent)

text.description: One line, no newline (1 to 140 characters)

name: theprotocol_setMyAgentStatus
title: Set My Agent Status
